name: Claro Colombia
body: HSTS, nosniff, and robots.txt open to OAI-SearchBot and ChatGPT-User. But https://www.claro.com.co/ redirects to http://www.claro.com.co/personas/, which then bounces back to https.
lesson: Write redirects with the full https:// target. An http Location adds a hop and an unencrypted request.
summary: www.claro.com.co scores 77 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 72 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 72 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /personas/, /negocios/, /empresas/, /institucional/ and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The content security policy has gaps
fix.evidence: script-src allows 'unsafe-inline', script-src allows 'unsafe-eval', object-src is not 'none', base-uri is not set.
fix.fix: Replace 'unsafe-inline' with nonces or hashes, limit hosts, and add object-src 'none' and base-uri 'self'.

fix.title: Core Web Vitals fail for real visitors
fix.evidence: Real Chrome users over the last 28 days on this page, at the 75th percentile: Largest Contentful Paint 4.5 s (poor), Interaction to Next Paint 664 ms (poor), Cumulative Layout Shift 0.05 (good). Source: Chrome UX Report through PageSpeed Insights.
fix.fix: Make the largest element arrive sooner: preload the hero image, serve it at the shown size in a modern format, and cut render-blocking scripts. Break up long JavaScript tasks behind clicks and taps, and defer…

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 25/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 91.7 s, Total Blocking Time 4375 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0, Speed Index 33.4 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.
